subject: Asset URI sandbox path-boundary audit

mechanism.resolve: weakly_canonical + lexically_relative must stay under assets/
mechanism.symlinks: followed then rejected if outside project root or assets/
mechanism.load: LoadOptions::enforce_uri_sandbox invokes resolve during JSON load

negative_matrix: symlink from assets/ to outside project
symlink from assets/ to project sibling outside assets/
load_scene_json with enforce_uri_sandbox rejects unsafe URIs
